title: Credits on Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Unit Removal, Window Bundle, Referral and On-Time Guarantee
content:
Credits reduce what is owed on an Entry & Patio Door Contract and are additive with one another, except as stated here. Credits are never paid out in cash while a balance is owed; a credit that takes the amount owed below zero becomes an overpayment refunded under the refund rules.

## Unit removed credit

A unit removed credit is granted only before order release (status signed or measured) and equals the series removal share of the base price per unit times the units removed, rounded to the cent. If the removal would leave fewer units than the minimum that must remain or bring the contract below the series minimum contract amount, the removal is not made and the cancellation terms apply instead.

## Window bundle discount credit

A window bundle discount credit equals the series bundle percentage of the signed door contract price, rounded to the cent. It is granted on the door contract when the customer signs a Ridgeline window contract within the bundle window of calendar days before or after this contract's signed date and neither contract is cancelled, once per pair of contracts.

The window bundle discount is granted only when the door contract's discount program is none. The discount program is read from the door contract record as fixed at signing.

| Discount program on the door contract | Window bundle discount |
|---|---|
| None | May be granted when the window contract conditions hold |
| Military, senior or first responder | Not granted |

## Referral credit

A referral credit of the series referral amount is granted when a household the customer referred signs its own Ridgeline contract and that contract reaches installed status, once per referred contract number and at most the series maximum per contract, counted as the referral credits already granted on this door contract.

## On-time guarantee credit

An on-time guarantee credit is the amount the Factory Production Orders terms compute and is booked when that order's credit is applied.

## Hypothetical cases

- **Unit removal.** A Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door contract of 3 units in status measured removes 1 unit: the credit is 100% of $2690.00 times 1, that is $2690.00, provided the contract keeps at least 1 unit and does not fall below the Portal 520 minimum contract amount. A contract with a single unit cannot remove it for credit; the cancellation terms apply instead.
- **Bundle window.** A door contract with no discount program, signed on 1 June, and a window contract signed on 31 July are 60 calendar days apart, within a 60-day bundle window. A window contract signed on 1 August, 61 days after, is outside it.
- **Bundle amount.** A Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door contract signed at $8493.00 with no discount program, at the Glide 720 bundle percentage of 4%: $339.72.
- **Referral limit.** Four referred households each sign and reach installed status; on a contract whose maximum is 3, three referral credits are granted and the fourth is not.
- **Credit beyond the balance.** A credit larger than the amount still owed is not paid out in cash; the part below zero becomes an overpayment refunded under the refund rules.
